title: Treasury Building, Brisbane
geometryBasis: Twenty native boundary vertices establish the complete four-street envelope and facade setbacks. Queensland’s approved conservation management plan confirms the four wings, raised pavilions, and the courtyard covered during the 1990s.
sectionBasis: The exact Figaro original fixes the Elizabeth Street sandstone, paired window bays, pilasters and roof balustrades. The exact State Library photograph fixes the surviving William Street composition. Mapped height and the conservation plan inform the other sides and the roof.
limitations: The model represents the completed former Treasury Building in 2005. Original eastern and northern masonry details, covered courtyard geometry, ornament and roof fixtures are approximate. Temporary signs and the neighboring Land Administration Building are excluded.

The original terrain remains unchanged. The four street grades are sampled from a composite model, which can include modern surface features. The entry stairs and vertical registration are approximate.
